en-US.promotionalText: Stack floating Sharlizes, beat 50 bosses and fly your own spaceship. 500 levels to play free. No loot boxes, and nothing random is ever sold.
en-US.description:
Stack the Sharliz as high as you can!

Sharliz Tower is a one-tap stacking game. A Sharliz swings from the crane, you tap to drop it, and the tower grows floor by floor. Land it just right for a perfect stack. Miss too often and the tower wobbles, tilts and comes crashing down.

500 LEVELS, 6 SEASONS
Build your way through Day, Night and Storm seasons, then into brand-new worlds: a jungle, a haunted castle, a pirate cove, a toy box, a circus, a pyramid, a ninja village, a pixel world, a dragon's lair, Atlantis and many more. Every world brings its own surprise, from wind and storms to cannons, sticky honey and fire-breathing dragons.

50 EPIC BOSSES
Every 10th level a boss tries to knock your tower down. Beat it to win its trophy hat, with a special power against that boss.

SPACE LEVELS
From level 89, fly your spaceship over each world before its boss and blast the boss's helpers. Upgrade your ship in the Garage.

DRESS UP YOUR SHARLIZ
Collect hats, outfits, glasses and cute 3D buddies that hatch from eggs and grow. Every item with a power has an upside and a downside, so you choose how you play.

BUILD YOUR SHARLIZ HOUSE
Reach player level 10 to open your own house. Decorate four rooms with 25 pieces of furniture, and unlock 10 designs for each one.

COLLECT THEM ALL
Two sticker books full of stickers to find: funny Sharliz stickers with shiny holo foils, a story told in cards, boss battles, worlds, buddies, and rare gold cards you earn by finishing special feats. Open the sticker packs you earn by playing and fill every page.

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
A daily gift, weekly missions, a weekly tournament, the monthly Sharliz Pass, holiday events like Halloween and Christmas, and five arcade mini-games.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
No ads. No account. Play offline. Your progress stays on your device. Everything in the game can be earned by playing, and optional purchases are there if you want them.

Plays in 14 languages: English, Hebrew, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Indonesian.

he.subtitle: בונים מגדל ומנצחים בוסים
he.promotionalText: בונים מגדל מדמויות שארליז מרחפות, מנצחים 50 בוסים ומעצבים בית משלכם. 500 שלבים בחינם. בלי קופסאות מזל, ושום דבר אקראי לא נמכר.
he.description:
השארליזים מרחפים מהמנוף, ואתם מחליטים מתי להפיל. נגיעה אחת, עוד קומה. יחזיק?

• 500 שלבים ב-6 עונות: יום, לילה, סערה, עולמות חדשים, הרפתקה ואגדה
• 50 בוסים עם שמות ואופי, בוס בכל שלב עשירי
• 42 מכשולים שמשנים את המשחק: רוח, קרח, ערפל, פורטלים, תותחים, דבש ועוד
• שלבי חלל: משלב 89, לפני כל בוס טסים בחללית מעל העולם ומשדרגים אותה במוסך
• אירועי חגים: ליל כל הקדושים וחג המולד, עם שלבים ופרסים מיוחדים
• בית השארליזים: 4 חדרים ו-225 עיצובי רהיטים לבחור מהם
• 19 חברים בתלת ממד, כל אחד עם יתרון אחד וחיסרון אחד
• שני אלבומי מדבקות ענקיים, מתנה יומית ומשימות
• בלי אינטרנט, בלי חשבון ובלי פרסומות

הוגן להורים:
המשחק חינמי, וכל 500 השלבים והבוסים פתוחים בלי לשלם. הקניות הן אופציונליות, כל פרס ידוע מראש, ושום דבר אקראי לא נמכר. רוב הפריטים אפשר להשיג גם במטבעות שמרוויחים במשחק.

המשחק זמין ב-14 שפות.

reviewNotes:
Hello App Review team,

Thank you for reviewing Sharliz Tower. Version 1.2 adds 200 new levels (500 in all, 50 bosses), space levels with a ship Garage, a Christmas event, free gift codes, a new character look, home-screen backgrounds and a smart difficulty, plus many fixes. The answers below are updated for this version.

1. Screen recording
Attached to our App Review reply of October 8, 2026 (version 1.0): launch, a level, the Shop and the purchase flow. The flow is unchanged.

2. Purpose and audience
A single-player, one-tap stacking game for families (children from about 9, parents, casual players). A "Sharliz" swings from a crane, the player taps to drop it, and the tower grows through 500 levels in 6 seasons, with a boss every 10th level. No ads, no account, no internet needed.

3. How to access the main features
No login, account, credentials or sample files are needed.
- Tap Play to start the next level, then tap the screen to drop each Sharliz.
- Bottom tab bar: Shop, Style (wardrobe), Missions, Modes (tournament, arcade) and Album (stickers, sticker shop).
- The small round icons on the left of the lobby open the Sharliz Pass, the Starter Pack offer, the Nest (eggs and buddies) and the Sharliz House (opens at player level 10).
- Space levels (new): from level 89, the level before each boss is a space level: the player flies a ship over that world. The Garage (rocket icon on the left of the lobby, from level 89) upgrades the ship with earned coins; some parts are earned only by finishing a whole season or event.
- Christmas event (new): opens by itself December 15-26, like our Halloween event: 10 stages, 5 free tries a day, extra tries for earned coins. Not shown outside those dates.
- Gift codes (new): Settings > Gift code. Free codes we hand out on our own social posts give a small gift of in-game items (coins, boosters, sticker packs). Codes are never sold and never unlock a paid item or feature: everything a code gives can be earned by playing. Offline, no data collected. Test code: SHARLIZ
- Settings has sound, language, Gift code and Restore Purchases.
- Tester report for our family testers: tap "Language" in Settings 5 times and a "Tester report" row appears. It shows play statistics kept only on this device, with Copy and Reset. Nothing is sent anywhere.

4. External services
Only Apple In-App Purchase (StoreKit). No login, ads, analytics, tracking, AI services or servers. New: once per launch it reads Apple's public App Store lookup to show an Update card when a newer version exists; nothing is sent. Progress is saved on the device only.

5. Regional differences
Same in every region (not offered in China mainland). The interface follows the device language (14 languages).

6. Regulated industry and third-party material
Not a regulated industry. No third-party brands, characters or licensed media: all characters, worlds, bosses and music were made for this game. Fonts under the SIL Open Font License.

7. In-app purchases
Purchases are optional: all 500 levels and bosses can be played without paying. All rewards are fixed, there are no random paid items, and sticker packs are never sold. The Sharliz House, the sticker shop, the home backgrounds, the ship Garage and the extra Christmas tries use only coins and stars earned in the game. This version adds no new in-app purchases.
- Coins in 4 sizes (consumable): the Shop tab.
- Sharliz Pass Premium (consumable, once per monthly season): the premium reward track. From the Pass icon on the left of the lobby.
- Starter Pack (one-time): 2,000 coins, boosters and the Star Halo hat. From the Offer icon on the left of the lobby, the top of the Shop, and once after winning level 5.
- Astronaut Suit and six Buddies, one-time: Cyborg, Unicorn, Baby Dragon, Robo Puppy, Galaxy Whale and Thunder Griffin. All in the Style tab (wardrobe), Buddy slot. Each can also be bought with earned coins.
- Restore Purchases: in Settings.

Thank you,
Tzach Tzanger
